Budgets & Course Units

Set department budgets per term type, then provide per-course unit values used for the cost factor calculation.

Department budgets

Cost factor = (sum of section units, with LCM sections multiplied by 1.5) divided by 15. Paired sections (e.g., MATH 110A + 110S) count once using the primary's units.
